description: This file defines the AppEnv class responsible for loading and accessing environment variables via the flutter_dotenv package, facilitating environment configuration management in a Flutter app.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading environment variables from a .env file and providing access to these variables during runtime.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes environment variables by loading the .env file bundled with the app.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specified environment variable key.
